BrochureContent.Content:
An exceptional detached family home of outstanding quality, Wintzerhaus occupies a prime position on the highly regarded Channel Road, one of Rush's most sought-after residential addresses. Finished to an exacting standard, this impressive contemporary residence combines luxurious family living with exceptional energy efficiency and impeccable presentation. 

Ideally located within walking distance of Rush village, beautiful beaches, excellent schools and a wide range of local amenities, the property also enjoys easy access to Rush & Lusk Train Station, Dublin Airport, Swords, the M1 and Dublin City Centre, making it an ideal choice for families seeking both coastal living and everyday convenience. 

Behind electric gates, the home immediately impresses with its beautifully landscaped gardens and generous cobble-lock driveway. Inside, a bright and welcoming entrance hall sets the tone for the stylish accommodation 
throughout. A versatile home office, which could equally serve as a fourth ground-floor bedroom, is complemented by a contemporary guest shower room, offering excellent flexibility for modern family living. 

At the heart of the home is an exceptional bespoke H Line kitchen, beautifully finished with premium integrated appliances, extensive cabinetry and generous workspace. Designed for both family life and entertaining, the kitchen flows effortlessly into a bright breakfast area, 
comfortable family room and spacious dining area before opening into the impressive formal living room, where a contemporary wood-burning stove creates a warm focal point. Large glazed openings flood the living spaces with natural light while providing seamless access to the sunny south-west facing rear garden. 

Upstairs, the generous accommodation continues with three spacious double bedrooms, including a luxurious principal suite complete with a walk-in dressing room and beautifully appointed en-suite shower room. Bedrooms two and three are served by a stylish Jack and Jill shower room, while a superb gym with adjoining sauna and shower provides an exceptional wellness space. This room could 
easily be converted into a fifth bedroom if required. A spacious hot press/drying room and fully floored attic provide excellent additional 
storage. 

Outside, the landscaped gardens have been carefully designed for both relaxation and low-maintenance living. The private south-west facing rear garden enjoys sunshine throughout the day and features extensive porcelain paving, composite decking, mature planting, feature solar lighting and a motorised awning, creating the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining. A fully insulated garage with EV charging point offers excellent versatility, while two garden sheds and a separate insulated utility room provide further practical 
storage. 

The specification throughout is exceptional. The property boasts a B2 BER rating together with 11 solar panels, an Eddi hot water diverter, Zappi EV charger, upgraded roof insulation with new soffits and fascia, new double-glazed glass windows throughout and a comprehensive security camera system. Every detail has been carefully considered to deliver a home of outstanding comfort, efficiency and long-term quality. 

Combining generous family accommodation, exceptional craftsmanship and an enviable coastal location, Wintzerhaus represents a 
rare opportunity to acquire a truly turnkey home in one of North County Dublin's most desirable settings. Offering an outstanding 
balance of luxury, practicality and convenience, this is a home designed for modern family living at its very best.

Attic - 
The attic is floored, contains the water take and pump for showers. There is a 210-litre hot water cylinder and offers plenty of extra storage space.

Outside - 
The property is approached through elegant double electric gates, providing an immediate sense of privacy, security and exclusivity. A beautifully cobble-locked driveway offers generous off-street parking for multiple vehicles, while the professionally landscaped front garden features a manicured lawn, mature planting, a water feature and thoughtfully positioned outdoor lighting, creating an impressive first impression both day and night. A substantial double-door garage is fitted with a Zappi electric vehicle charging point and has been fully insulated with tiled flooring, making it an exceptionally versatile space that could be used as a garage, workshop, home gym or hobby room. To the rear, the enclosed south-westerly facing garden is a true outdoor sanctuary, enjoying sunshine throughout the day and into the evening. Designed with both relaxation and entertaining in mind, it features an extensive porcelain tiled patio, a raised composite deck with beautifully planted raised beds, mature shrubs and atmospheric solar lighting. A motorised retractable awning, discreetly housed within a sleek cassette on the rear elevation, provides welcome shade on warmer days, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining or simply unwinding. The garage has both front and rear access, while two additional storage sheds provide excellent practical storage solutions.

Outside Utility Room -
